prompt:
You are a credit rating analyst. Using only the information below and general knowledge predating 2026-05-05, assign the issuer a letter credit rating on the 21-grade scale below (finest granularity you can justify).
Valid answers (choose exactly one): AAA, AA+, AA, AA-, A+, A, A-, BBB+, BBB, BBB-, BB+, BB, BB-, B+, B, B-, CCC+, CCC, CCC-, CC, C.
Company information (as of 2026-05-05):
Fiscal period 2026 Q1 (filed 2026-05-05). Revenue 6,020M, gross margin 65%, operating income 1,360M (operating margin 23%), net income 874M, diluted EPS 1.6. Total assets 117,776M, total liabilities 84,798M, shareholders' equity 31,808M. Current assets 6,623M vs current liabilities 12,594M (current ratio 0.53), retained earnings 15,795M.
Reason briefly in 1-3 sentences. Then, on a separate final line, output exactly:
DECISION: <one label>
raw_response:
The reported metrics indicate strong operating profitability (23% margin) and earnings power, but this is offset by high leverage (liabilities ~2.7\times equity) and weak liquidity (current ratio 0.53). These characteristics are consistent with a large financial institution whose ratings are typically capped in the upper-investment-grade range once capital and asset-quality factors are considered.
DECISION: A-
